appraisals_score_range_check.name: appraisals_score_range_check
appraisals_score_range_check.value:
("appraisals"."journal_recent_advances_learning_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."journal_recent_advances_learning_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."patient_lab_skill_learning_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."patient_lab_skill_learning_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."self_directed_learning_teaching_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."self_directed_learning_teaching_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."departmental_interdepartmental_learning_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."departmental_interdepartmental_learning_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."external_outreach_cme_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."external_outreach_cme_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."thesis_research_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."thesis_research_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."logbook_maintenance_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."logbook_maintenance_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."patient_care_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."patient_care_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."communication_skill_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."communication_skill_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)
    AND ("appraisals"."professionalism_score" IS NULL OR "appraisals"."professionalism_score" BETWEEN 1 AND 9)

appraisals_low_score_remediation_check.name: appraisals_low_score_remediation_check
appraisals_low_score_remediation_check.value:
num_nonnulls(
      "appraisals"."journal_recent_advances_learning_score", "appraisals"."patient_lab_skill_learning_score",
      "appraisals"."self_directed_learning_teaching_score", "appraisals"."departmental_interdepartmental_learning_score",
      "appraisals"."external_outreach_cme_score", "appraisals"."thesis_research_score", "appraisals"."logbook_maintenance_score",
      "appraisals"."patient_care_score", "appraisals"."communication_skill_score", "appraisals"."professionalism_score"
    ) = 0
    OR (
      "appraisals"."journal_recent_advances_learning_score" >= 4 AND "appraisals"."patient_lab_skill_learning_score" >= 4
      AND "appraisals"."self_directed_learning_teaching_score" >= 4 AND "appraisals"."departmental_interdepartmental_learning_score" >= 4
      AND "appraisals"."external_outreach_cme_score" >= 4 AND "appraisals"."thesis_research_score" >= 4
      AND "appraisals"."logbook_maintenance_score" >= 4 AND "appraisals"."patient_care_score" >= 4
      AND "appraisals"."communication_skill_score" >= 4 AND "appraisals"."professionalism_score" >= 4
    )
    OR NULLIF(BTRIM("appraisals"."remediation_suggestions"), '') IS NOT NULL

users_department_required.name: users_department_required
users_department_required.value: "users"."role" NOT IN ('student', 'professor', 'hod') OR "users"."department_id" IS NOT NULL
